WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns
    WHERE sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
        AND sr_returned_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001
        )
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg_return AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_store_sk,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_avg_return sar ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sar.ctr_store_sk AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_threshold
JOIN store s ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND s.s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_month = 5 AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk 
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') 
    AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') 
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
WHERE ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(SR_RETURN_AMT) AS ctr_total_return 
    FROM 
        store_returns,
        date_dim 
    WHERE 
        sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
        AND d_year = 2001 
        AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 182 AND 241 
    GROUP BY 
        sr_customer_sk, 
        sr_store_sk, 
        sr_reason_sk
)

    c_customer_id 
FROM 
    customer_total_return ctr1 
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ctr_store_sk,
            AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_plus_20_percent 
        FROM 
            customer_total_return 
        GROUP BY 
            ctr_store_sk
    ) avg_ctr 
        ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = avg_ctr.ctr_store_sk 
        AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > avg_ctr.avg_plus_20_percent 
    JOIN store 
        ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk 
        AND s_state IN ('IA', 'NE', 'TX') 
    JOIN customer 
        ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
        AND c_birth_month = 6 
        AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1934 AND 1940 
    JOIN customer_demographics 
        ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk 
        AND cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'U') 
        AND cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree') 
        AND cd_gender = 'F' 
WHERE 
    ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 24 AND 27 
ORDER BY 
    c_customer_id 
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_customer AS (

        cd_education_status,
        cd_purchase_estimate,
        cd_credit_rating,

    FROM customer c
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
                                       AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('M', 'U')
                                       AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'College', '4 yr Degree')
                                       AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (4, 5)
),
store_sales_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
),
web_or_catalog_sales_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
)
SELECT 
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) cnt3,
    cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt4,
    cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt5,
    cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) cnt6
FROM filtered_customer fc

INNER JOIN web_or_catalog_sales_customers wcsc ON fc.c_customer_sk = wcsc.customer_sk

SELECT i_item_id,
       s_state,
       grouping(s_state) g_state,
       avg(ss_quantity) agg1,
       avg(ss_list_price) agg2,
       avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3,
       avg(ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM store_sales
JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'D'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
) cd ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
) d ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'IN'
) s ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
) i ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999)
  AND store_sales.ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Electronics')
  AND store_sales.ss_store_sk IN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state = 'IN')
  AND store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk IN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id,
         s_state
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss AS (
    SELECT ca_county,
           d_qoy,
           d_year,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    INNER JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
    INNER JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
        AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy') 
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
    WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
),
ws AS (
    SELECT ca_county,
           d_qoy,
           d_year,
           SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    INNER JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
    INNER JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
        AND i_color IN ('purple', 'sandy') 
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 55
    WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 91
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
)
SELECT ss1.ca_county,
       ss1.d_year,
       ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,
       ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase,
       ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase,
       ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM (SELECT * FROM ss WHERE d_qoy = 1 AND d_year = 2001) ss1
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ss WHERE d_qoy = 2 AND d_year = 2001) ss2 ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ss WHERE d_qoy = 3 AND d_year = 2001) ss3 ON ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ws WHERE d_qoy = 1 AND d_year = 2001) ws1 ON ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ws WHERE d_qoy = 2 AND d_year = 2001) ws2 ON ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ss2.ca_county = ws2.ca_county
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ws WHERE d_qoy = 3 AND d_year = 2001) ws3 ON ws2.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ss3.ca_county = ws3.ca_county
WHERE CASE
          WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales
          ELSE NULL
      END > CASE
                WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales
                ELSE NULL
            END
  AND CASE
          WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales
          ELSE NULL
      END > CASE
                WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales
                ELSE NULL
            END
ORDER BY store_q1_q2_increase;

    s_county,

    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 4
) AS d2
JOIN store_returns ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
                  AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
                  AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk

JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
GROUP BY
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,

    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,

    s_state,
    s_zip

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT min(s_store_name),
       min(s_company_id),
       min(s_street_number),
       min(s_street_name),
       min(s_suite_number),
       min(s_city),
       min(s_zip),
       min(ss_ticket_number),
       min(ss_sold_date_sk),
       min(sr_returned_date_sk),
       min(ss_item_sk),
       min(d1.d_date_sk)
FROM (SELECT * FROM store_sales) AS ss
JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_returns) AS sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
                                         AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
                                         AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
                                         AND ss.ss_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk -- Added by transitive predicate
JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_suite_number, s_city, s_zip, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('MI','NC','WI')) AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_dow = 4) AS d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 2) AS d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
                                                                      AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2.d_date;

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH cs_or_ws_sales_filtered AS ( /* 应用STRATEGY_CTE_DECOMPOSITION: 分解UNION ALL子查询为独立的CTE */
  SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM catalog_sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM web_sales
),
filtered_item AS ( /* 应用JOIN_CONDITION_PUSH 和 FILTER_INTO_JOIN: 将item表的过滤条件提前 */
  SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Sports' AND i_class = 'camping'
),
filtered_date_dim_cust AS ( /* 应用JOIN_CONDITION_PUSH 和 FILTER_INTO_JOIN: 将date_dim和customer表的过滤条件提前 */
  SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2001
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945
),
my_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk
  FROM cs_or_ws_sales_filtered cs_or_ws_sales
  JOIN filtered_item i ON cs_or_ws_sales.item_sk = i.i_item_sk /* 应用FILTER_INTO_JOIN: 连接条件合并过滤 */
  JOIN filtered_date_dim_cust d ON cs_or_ws_sales.sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk /* 应用FILTER_INTO_JOIN */
  JOIN filtered_customer c ON cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk /* 应用FILTER_INTO_JOIN */
  WHERE cs_or_ws_sales.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
),
month_seq_const AS ( /* 应用STRATEGY_CTE_DECOMPOSITION 和 优化建议: 将重复子查询提取为常量CTE */
  SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 AS lower_bound, d_month_seq + 3 AS upper_bound
  FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 6
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers mc
  JOIN store_sales ss ON mc.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN store s ON ca.ca_county = s.s_county AND ca.ca_state = s.s_state /* 应用FILTER_INTO_JOIN */
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN month_seq_const msc /* 引入预计算的常量 */
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
    AND s.s_state IN ('IA','MD','MO','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA')
    AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN msc.lower_bound AND msc.upper_bound
  GROUP BY c_customer_sk
),
segments AS (
  SELECT CAST((revenue/50) AS INT) AS segment FROM my_revenue
)
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, segment * 50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH wss AS (
  SELECT 
    d_week_seq,
    ss_store_sk,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
                    AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 17 * 0.01 AND 37 * 0.01
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1207 + 23
  GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk
)  
SELECT 
  s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1,
  sun_sales1 / sun_sales2, mon_sales1 / mon_sales2,
  tue_sales1 / tue_sales2, wed_sales1 / wed_sales2, thu_sales1 / thu_sales2,
  fri_sales1 / fri_sales2, sat_sales1 / sat_sales2
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s_store_name AS s_store_name1, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1,
    s_store_id AS s_store_id1, sun_sales AS sun_sales1,
    mon_sales AS mon_sales1, tue_sales AS tue_sales1,
    wed_sales AS wed_sales1, thu_sales AS thu_sales1,
    fri_sales AS fri_sales1, sat_sales AS sat_sales1
  FROM wss, store, date_dim d
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq 
    AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
    AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1207 + 11
    AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX')
) y,
(
  SELECT 
    s_store_name AS s_store_name2, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2,
    s_store_id AS s_store_id2, sun_sales AS sun_sales2,
    mon_sales AS mon_sales2, tue_sales AS tue_sales2,
    wed_sales AS wed_sales2, thu_sales AS thu_sales2,
    fri_sales AS fri_sales2, sat_sales AS sat_sales2
  FROM wss, store, date_dim d
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq 
    AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
    AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 + 12 AND 1207 + 23
    AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX')
) x
WHERE s_store_id1 = s_store_id2
  AND d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 52
ORDER BY s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH 
    filtered_d1 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001),
    filtered_d2 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq FROM date_dim),
    filtered_d3 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim),
    filtered_item AS (SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_category FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')),
    filtered_cd AS (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6),
    filtered_hd AS (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential = '>10000')
SELECT 
    i_item_desc,
    w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM 
    catalog_sales
    JOIN inventory ON (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk AND inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity)
    JOIN warehouse ON (w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk)
    JOIN filtered_item item ON (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk)
    JOIN filtered_cd cd ON (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk)
    JOIN filtered_hd hd ON (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk)
    JOIN filtered_d1 d1 ON (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk)
    JOIN filtered_d2 d2 ON (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk)
    JOIN filtered_d3 d3 ON (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day')
    LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON (cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number)
WHERE 
    d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37
GROUP BY 
    i_item_desc,
    w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY 
    total_cnt DESC,
    i_item_desc,
    w_warehouse_name,
    d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

SELECT MIN(i_item_sk),
       MIN(w_warehouse_name),
       MIN(d1.d_week_seq),
       MIN(cs_item_sk),
       MIN(cs_order_number),
       MIN(inv_item_sk)
FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS catalog_sales
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM inventory) AS inventory ON (catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = inventory.inv_item_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM warehouse) AS warehouse ON (warehouse.w_warehouse_sk = inventory.inv_warehouse_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) AS item ON (item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7) AS customer_demographics ON (catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000') AS household_demographics ON (catalog_sales.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d1 ON (catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d2 ON (inventory.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk)
     INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim) AS d3 ON (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk)
     LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON (catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk)
     LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk AND catalog_returns.cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number)
WHERE d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
  AND inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand < catalog_sales.cs_quantity
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
  AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND inventory.inv_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND warehouse.w_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND inventory.inv_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND item.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_hdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND household_demographics.hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND d1.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND inventory.inv_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND d2.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND d3.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND item.i_item_sk = inventory.inv_item_sk;

tpch.rewritten_query:
with ssr as (
  select 
    s_store_id as store_id,
    sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
    sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from date_dim
  join store_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
                      and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) 
                                           and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
  left outer join store_returns on store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk 
                                and store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number
  join store on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  join item on store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
              and item.i_current_price > 50 
              and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
  join promotion on store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
                   and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
                   and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  where store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by s_store_id
),
csr as (
  select 
    cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id,
    sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
    sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from date_dim
  join catalog_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk 
                        and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) 
                                             and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
  left outer join catalog_returns on catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk 
                                  and catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number
  join catalog_page on catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
  join item on catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
              and item.i_current_price > 50 
              and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
  join promotion on catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
                   and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
                   and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  where catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
  select 
    web_site_id,
    sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
    sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from date_dim
  join web_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk 
                    and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) 
                                         and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day
  left outer join web_returns on web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk 
                              and web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
  join web_site on web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
  join item on web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
              and item.i_current_price > 50 
              and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
  join promotion on web_sales.ws_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk 
                   and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
                   and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N'
                   and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y'
  where web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  group by web_site_id
)
select 
  channel,
  id,
  sum(sales) as sales,
  sum(returns) as returns,
  sum(profit) as profit
from (
  select 
    'store channel' as channel,
    'store' || store_id as id,
    sales,
    returns,
    profit
  from ssr
  union all
  select 
    'catalog channel' as channel,
    'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id as id,
    sales,
    returns,
    profit
  from csr
  union all
  select 
    'web channel' as channel,
    'web_site' || web_site_id as id,
    sales,
    returns,
    profit
  from wsr
) x
group by rollup (channel, id)
order by channel, id
limit 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM 
    catalog_returns,
    date_dim,
    customer_address
  WHERE 
    cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_year = 1998
    AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    AND ca_state = 'IL'  -- FILTER_CORRELATE: 将主查询条件 `ca_state = 'IL'` 下推到CTE中
  GROUP BY 
    cr_returning_customer_sk,
    ca_state
),
state_avg AS (
  -- FILTER_SUB_QUERY_TO_CORRELATE: 将相关子查询转换为派生表JOIN
  -- 预计算每个州（此处仅为‘IL’）的平均值的1.2倍
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_return_1_2
  FROM 
    customer_total_return
  GROUP BY 
    ctr_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  ca_street_number,
  ca_street_name,
  ca_street_type,
  ca_suite_number,
  ca_city,
  ca_county,
  ca_state,
  ca_zip,
  ca_country,
  ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type,
  ctr_total_return
FROM 
  customer_total_return ctr1
  JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
  -- 将子查询条件替换为与派生表的JOIN和谓词比较
  JOIN state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
WHERE 
  ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_return_1_2
  -- 注意：`ca_state = 'IL'` 条件已在上游CTE中应用，此处可省略
ORDER BY 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name,
  ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset,
  ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM
    web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1999
    INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE
    (
        (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
            AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'U'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
            AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
            AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree'
            AND cd2.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree'
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'M'
            AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'M'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
            AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'College'
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        )
    )
    AND (
        (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('NE', 'TN', 'TX')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
        )
        OR (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
        )
        OR (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('MS', 'TN', 'TX')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
        )
    )
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY
    SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100;

WITH store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales_filtered ssf
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales_filtered csf
    WHERE csf.c_last_name = ssf.c_last_name
      AND csf.c_first_name = ssf.c_first_name
      AND csf.d_date = ssf.d_date
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM web_sales_filtered wsf
    WHERE wsf.c_last_name = ssf.c_last_name
      AND wsf.c_first_name = ssf.c_first_name
      AND wsf.d_date = ssf.d_date
);

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center,
       cc_name AS Call_Center_Name,
       cc_manager AS Manager,
       SUM(cr_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss
FROM call_center
JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_year = 2001
        AND d_moy = 10) d ON cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk,
             c_current_cdemo_sk,
             c_current_hdemo_sk,
             c_current_addr_sk
      FROM customer
      JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk
            FROM customer_demographics
            WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown')
               OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) cd ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk
      JOIN (SELECT hd_demo_sk
            FROM household_demographics
            WHERE hd_buy_potential LIKE 'Unknown%') hd ON hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk
      JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk
            FROM customer_address
            WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -7) ca ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk) c ON cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager
ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC;

WITH avg_discount AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_ext_discount_amt
    FROM 
        web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        dd.d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND CAST('2001-01-31' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77
        AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.32
    GROUP BY 
        ws_item_sk
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM 
    item i
    JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND CAST('2001-01-31' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY
    LEFT JOIN avg_discount ad ON ws.ws_item_sk = ad.ws_item_sk
WHERE 
    (i.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 749 AND 948 OR i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))
    AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_ext_discount_amt
ORDER BY 
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_amount
    FROM 
        web_sales,
        date_dim
    WHERE 
        ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        AND d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND '1999-06-20'
        AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.69 AND 0.84
    GROUP BY 
        ws_item_sk
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM 
    (SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_ext_discount_amt FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS ws
JOIN 
    (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 AND 622 OR i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women'))) AS i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN 
    (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND '1999-06-20') AS d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
JOIN 
    avg_discount AS ad
    ON ad.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
WHERE 
    ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_amount
GROUP BY ()
ORDER BY 
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

       SUM(ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",

JOIN date_dim ON ws1.ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
JOIN web_site ON ws1.ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk

  AND ws1.ws_list_price BETWEEN 111 AND 140
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1

              WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number
                AND ws1.ws_warehouse_sk <> ws2.ws_warehouse_sk)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1

                  WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = wr1.wr_order_number

GROUP BY ws1.ws_order_number
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number)
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_name),
       MIN(sm_type),
       MIN(cc_name),
       MIN(cs_order_number),
       MIN(cs_item_sk)
FROM (SELECT cs_ship_date_sk,
             cs_warehouse_sk,
             cs_ship_mode_sk,
             cs_call_center_sk,
             cs_order_number,
             cs_item_sk
      FROM catalog_sales
      WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 77 AND 106
        AND cs_ship_date_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND cs_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND cs_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL
        AND cs_call_center_sk IS NOT NULL) cs
JOIN (SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_warehouse_name
      FROM warehouse
      WHERE w_gmt_offset = -5
        AND w_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL) w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN (SELECT sm_ship_mode_sk, sm_type
      FROM ship_mode
      WHERE sm_type = 'TWO DAY'
        AND sm_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL) sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN (SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name
      FROM call_center
      WHERE cc_class = 'small'
        AND cc_call_center_sk IS NOT NULL) cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1193 AND 1193 + 23
        AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
  AND sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
  AND cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
  AND d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk;

FROM 
    (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music') AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_item1,
    (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 AND 96 AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_item2,
    (SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_list_price, ss_sold_date_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250 AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_s1,
    (SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_list_price, ss_sold_date_sk FROM store_sales WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 250 AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL AND ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_s2,
    (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999 AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_date_dim,
    customer,
    customer_address,
    (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL) AS filtered_cd
WHERE filtered_item1.i_item_sk < filtered_item2.i_item_sk
    AND filtered_s1.ss_ticket_number = filtered_s2.ss_ticket_number
    AND filtered_s1.ss_item_sk = filtered_item1.i_item_sk
    AND filtered_s2.ss_item_sk = filtered_item2.i_item_sk
    AND filtered_s1.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    AND customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk

    AND filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk = filtered_s1.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND filtered_item1.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND filtered_item2.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND filtered_s1.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND filtered_s2.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND filtered_s1.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND customer.c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND customer.c_current_addr_sk IS NOT NULL AND customer.c_current_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND customer_address.ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL

original_query: select  sum(cs_ext_discount_amt)  as "excess discount amount" from    catalog_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id in (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) or i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 and 57) and i_item_sk = cs_item_sk and d_date between '1999-01-14' and         cast('1999-01-14' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk and cs_ext_discount_amt      > (          select             1.3 * avg(cs_ext_discount_amt)          from             catalog_sales            ,date_dim          where               cs_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '1999-01-14' and                              cast('1999-01-14' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk           and cs_list_price between 236 and 265           and cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 65 * 0.01       ) order by sum(cs_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount"
FROM
    (SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_ext_discount_amt, cs_sold_date_sk FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL) cs
    JOIN
    (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57) AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN
    (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND '1999-04-14' AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
        cs_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
     FROM
        (SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_ext_discount_amt, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_list_price, cs_sales_price FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL) cs_avg
        JOIN
        (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND '1999-04-14' AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) d_avg ON cs_avg.cs_sold_date_sk = d_avg.d_date_sk
        JOIN
        (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57) AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) i_avg ON cs_avg.cs_item_sk = i_avg.i_item_sk
     WHERE
        cs_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 265
        AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.65
     GROUP BY cs_item_sk
    ) avg_sub ON cs.cs_item_sk = avg_sub.cs_item_sk
WHERE
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > avg_sub.avg_discount
GROUP BY ()
ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88) AS ws
JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 AND 593 OR i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))) AS i
  ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY
      AND web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88
      AND web_sales.ws_sales_price / web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 85 * 0.01 AND 100 * 0.01
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk
) AS sub
  ON sub.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND sub.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > sub.avg_discount
  AND i.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND d.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND sub.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ws_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt_threshold
    FROM
        web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            AND d.d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND (CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY)
    WHERE
        ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 69 * 0.01 AND 84 * 0.01
    GROUP BY
        ws_item_sk
)
SELECT
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM
    web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        AND (i.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 AND 622 OR i.i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women'))
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        AND d.d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND (CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY)
    LEFT JOIN avg_discount_cte ad ON ws.ws_item_sk = ad.ws_item_sk
WHERE
    ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_discount_amt_threshold
    AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND i.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND d.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ad.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;
